{{Short description|Surveying on 2021–2025 US presidency}}
{{Use American English|date=April 2023}}
{{Use mdy dates|date=April 2023}}
{{Joe Biden series}}
This is a list of opinion polls taken on the [[presidency of Joe Biden]] in 2022. To navigate between years, see [[opinion polling on the Biden administration]]. For 2023 opinion polling, see [[2023 opinion polling on the Biden administration]].

Throughout 2022, Biden continued having a higher disapproval than approval rating, which had begun in [[2021 opinion polling on the Joe Biden administration#August|August 2021]].<ref>{{Cite news |last=Strozewski |first=Zoe |date=May 20, 2022 |title=Joe Biden's Approval Rating Sinks Below Donald Trump's |work=[[Newsweek]] |url=https://www.newsweek.com/joe-bidens-approval-rating-sinks-below-donald-trumps-1708787 |access-date=June 4, 2022}}</ref> Biden's approval was steady throughout the year at approximately 42% with the exception of a significant dip during the summer which saw [[2021–2023 inflation surge|a period]] of high gas prices and high inflation.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Biden's approval ratings hit all-time lows in CNBC poll |url=https://www.nbcnews.com/meet-the-press/meetthepressblog/bidens-approval-ratings-hit-time-lows-cnbc-poll-rcna38240 |access-date=2023-03-22 |website=NBC News |date=July 14, 2022 |language=en}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |last=Skelley |first=Geoffrey |date=July 14, 2022 |title=What's Behind Biden's Record-Low Approval Rating? |url=https://fivethirtyeight.com/features/whats-behind-bidens-record-low-approval-rating/ |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220714100349/https://fivethirtyeight.com/features/whats-behind-bidens-record-low-approval-rating/ |url-status=dead |archive-date=July 14, 2022 |access-date=2023-03-22 |website=FiveThirtyEight |language=en-US}}</ref> At certain points, two-thirds of Americans disapproved of Biden's handling of the economy.<ref>{{Cite news |last=Riccardi |first=Nicholas |date=May 20, 2022 |title=Biden's approval dips to lowest of presidency: AP-NORC poll |work=[[Associated Press]] |url=https://apnews.com/article/biden-approval-rating-drops-ap-norc-poll-d41bce85e1b062b588a32908b2affa65 |access-date=June 4, 2022}}</ref>

According to the [[Gallup, Inc.|Gallup poll]], during Biden's seventh quarter in office (defined as July 20 to October 19) he had approximately a 42% approval rating. This was found comparable to other presidents at the same time during their first term since [[Jimmy Carter]], with the exception of the majority approval enjoyed by both [[George H. W. Bush]] and [[George W. Bush]].<ref>Jones, Jeffrey M., "[https://news.gallup.com/poll/403970/biden-job-approval-back-down.aspx Biden Job Approval Back Down to 40%]," October 22, 2022, ''Gallup, Inc.'' Retrieved November 24, 2022.</ref>

== By race ==
In December 2021 a PBS/Marist poll, found that just 33% of Hispanics approve of Biden, while 65% disapprove. In contrast, 40% of whites approve, while 56% disapprove.<ref>{{cite web | url=https://www.nationalreview.com/corner/with-hispanic-support-more-bad-news-for-democrats/ | title=With Hispanic Support, More Bad News for Democrats | website=[[National Review]] | date=December 21, 2021 }}</ref>

In May 2022, a Quinnipiac poll found that Biden had an approval rating from Hispanics at 26%, White voters at 29%, and 63% from Black voters.<ref>{{cite web | url=https://www.foxnews.com/politics/biden-hispanic-approval-rating-plummets | title=Biden's Hispanic approval ratings plummets to 26% in new poll | website=[[Fox News]] | date=May 19, 2022 }}</ref> In June 3–6, 2022, a Quinnipiac poll found that Biden had his then lowest approval rating from Hispanics at 24%, and 49% of Blacks.<ref>{{cite web | url=https://nypost.com/2022/06/09/biden-approval-at-22-among-young-adults-24-among-hispanics-poll/ | title=Biden approval sinks to 22% among young adults, 24% among Hispanics: Poll | date=June 9, 2022 }}</ref>

On July 19, 2022, a Quinnipiac poll found that Biden had his lowest approval rating from Hispanics at 19%, while 70% disapprove.<ref>{{cite web | url=https://news.yahoo.com/poll-shows-biden-19-percent-195548029.html | title=Poll Shows Biden at 19 Percent Approval among Hispanics | date=July 20, 2022 }}</ref>
